design_rules: closed ferrite can: tube + top cap + bottom cap, all MnZn mu_r >= 2000, wall >= 5 mm for 47 dB (3 mm gives 42 dB)
cable and flow penetrations <= 4 mm and through the SIDE wall, never through a cap centre
board loops: route returns directly under signals; keep each board's enclosed loop area under 1 cm2
AB1 BLANK asserted from before TX turn-off until 2-3 us after (cuts the residual EMF)
head_bay_field.note: S = 1 + mu_r t / (2 a) is the transverse closed-cylinder estimate; axial shielding of a can with end caps is lower and must be measured.

syntactic silicone (Pt-cure 2-part + gla.exotherm: very low (addition cure, <10 K in 50 cm3)
syntactic silicone (Pt-cure 2-part + gla.use: head bay, boards and antenna region

alumina-filled epoxy or silicone (50-60.use: NPM hot zone only (FETs, clamp resistors)

glass_bubble_truth: Hollow glass microspheres LOWER density, dielectric constant and shrinkage, and soften the exotherm, but they are thermal INSULATORS (k about 0.12-0.15 W/mK). They do not improve heat dissipation; heat is handled by low head dissipation, solid printed walls, and alumina-filled potting only where a hot part sits.

procedure: 1 conformal coat boards (silicone or parylene), fit ferrite can parts
2 vacuum-pot the bay module (3 boards + septum) in its sleeve through the lid port, vent opposite, 3 lifts max
3 wipe-fill the winding grooves on face, rim, underside and inner walls BEFORE bonding the sensor board
4 bond SB1 with epoxy film, bezel with epoxy, skid with VHB
5 final cure and leak test (pressure decay 20 kPa)

head_thermal.rule: print the head body SOLID (100% infill); keep head dissipation <= 1 W; regulation losses live outside the head (pre-regulated 5.5 V / 3.6 V rails)

ribbon.type: 12-conductor flat silicone ribbon, 1.0 mm pitch, AWG 28 (12 mm wide x 0.5 mm), two ribbons (POWER and SIGNAL) in separate chambers
ribbon.note: 3 conductors in parallel per rail leg; AWG28 is rated about 0.7 A each

handle_power.pack: 7S1P 18650 folded 4+3 in a U-pack, 290 x 38 x 20 mm, about 460 g, 90.7 Wh
handle_power.holdup: supercap bridge 1 F / 27 V (10 x 10 F 2.7 V cells in series, balanced) on the PM1 cartridge-B input: about 40 s of scan-mode operation during a swap
handle_power.swap_time_s: < 10 typical; boost mode is not guaranteed through a swap

mass_and_balance.warning: head-heavy: about 2.0 kg.m about the hand. Shorten the shaft, move the hand forward, or drop the 2nd potting lift in the NPM to reduce it. Measure with a pendulum test.

cavities.IP_target: IP68 (potted, no openings except side cable port)
cavities.shield: closed MnZn can 5 mm + copper-foil E-shield
cavities.ports: 1 fill D6 + 1 vent D4 in the lid

ratings_note: IP targets are design goals for a sealed, potted, gasketed build; none is certified. Dielectric strength of potting spacing is design-checked only.
